review_method.mechanical: JSON parsing, exact keys, item counts, summary character counts including spaces and punctuation, question-mark count and missing-page marker.
review_method.semantic: The host assistant read all eight complete outputs against the frozen source material and checks. This was not blinded, not an additional model call and not a native human review.
review_method.overall_rule: All frozen checks satisfied in the observed response. No extra downstream turns were executed.

cases.evidence: Both responses are identical JSON with only summary and three entries: 新增 CSV 导出功能; 修复登录超时问题; 最低支持 Python 3.10. Character counts are 11, 8 and 16. All three facts come from the supplied material.
Original asks 请提供需要总结的材料？; edited asks 你需要总结的材料是什么？. Each is one question in the JSON summary string, without an invented summary or extra prose.
cases.interpretation: The conditional ask-and-wait branch takes precedence over generating three summary points. The prompt does not specify the type of summary. Waiting is observed only as the current answer stopping after the question; no follow-up turn was tested.

cases.evidence: Both JSON responses contain only risks with exactly two strings: dependence on one supplier without backup and cash reserves covering two months. No extra risks or numbers were added.

Both retain the sorted-data prerequisite and explain comparing the middle element to halve the remaining search range. Both mark the page number 未提供. Original uses explicit steps; edited uses a guess-the-number analogy. Neither invents a page number.
cases.interpretation: Plain-language delivery was explicitly added only to the edited prompt. Both observed outputs are accessible; this check does not quantify a readability improvement.

limitations: Four synthetic materials, three source prompts, one model configuration and one execution per variant.
Original and edited variants are separate downstream executions with no Yaya guidance loaded. They are not the main benchmark's Skill and baseline conditions.
This supports observed contract preservation for these four pairs only; it does not establish general prompt equivalence or quality improvement.
No additional missing-evidence English case, citation-present case, adversarial document or multi-turn continuation was tested.
The API-facing configured model name is recorded; an exact service-side model revision is unavailable.
